reason: The description gives no voltage or current, so it fits all four BMS PCBAs; BMS-19545 is picked because it comes from the same supplier (Suntronix) and $5.06 is about 1.9x its $2.61 production price, consistent with a service/spares buy, but BMS-19562 (~$4.91, other supplier), BMS-19537 (~2.04x) and BMS-19554 remain plausible.
